_doc: RixPicks league registry - single source of truth for all league wiring. Every script reads this. A league reaches FULL STANDARD when: ingestion (espn), odds routing (odds_api and/or kalshi), card rendering, pulse, grading path all verified live. J-049A: odds_api is only queried for leagues carded that day (manifest-gated, 16 credits/day cap).

NCAAB.note: odds-API adds basketball_ncaab when season starts (Nov); Kalshi series exists, opens with season

MLS.note: logos via ESPN meta id-URL, not abbr CDN

NWSL.note: no odds-API coverage; Kalshi + Polymarket routing only

PGA.note: odds-API covers majors only (per-tournament keys); weekly routing Kalshi/Polymarket

ATP.note: odds-API tennis keys are per-tournament when covered (currently none active)

WTA.note: per-tournament odds keys; Kalshi match markets live

NASCAR.note: ESPN slug verified live (nascar-premier = Cup). No odds-API coverage; Kalshi + Polymarket

Boxing.note: ESPN has no boxing scoreboard API; slate data from odds-API + Kalshi
